Information on hand-off notes at the skyport
The desk wrote this for everyone using the desk
Hand-off notes at the skyport

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways uses hand-off notes to keep pet travel support steady from one shift to the next. These notes help each team member follow the same plan, so travelers receive clear guidance before departure and pets are handled with care.

A hand-off note should be brief, plain, and complete. It should record the current status of the booking, any recent changes, and any care points that matter for the traveler or the animal. If a pet needs special handling, that detail belongs in the note so the next agent can review it without delay. This helps reduce confusion and keeps service consistent.

The senior coordinator reviews daily service decisions and makes sure the desk is using the same standards throughout the day. When a question reaches the desk, staff should update the note with what was agreed, not only what was asked. That way, the next person can see the full picture and continue support without repeating work that is already done.

Crew guidance also depends on good notes. The department shares practical instructions with crews so they know what to expect when a pet arrives, how the hand-off should proceed, and what needs a closer check. Clear wording matters here. Short sentences are easier to read quickly, especially during busy travel periods.

Travelers do not need to write long reports. A simple note that names the issue, the action taken, and any next step is usually enough. If the traveler has already been told something important, the note should reflect that message in plain language. This helps the desk keep everyone informed and ready.

When the hand-off is complete, the note should be updated once more so the record matches the latest status. Good hand-off notes support smooth service, protect animal welfare, and help Aurelia Skyways keep each journey organized.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
